description: Renovate owns the toolchain pins only: mise.toml plus the files that must match it (go.mod go directive, package.json packageManager, CI golangci-lint), all in one grouped PR so scripts/check-toolchain.sh stays green. Dependabot owns Go modules, npm, Actions and Docker (NFR-MAINT-008). Inert until the Renovate GitHub App is installed.

customManagers.description: go.mod go directive follows mise.toml go
CI golangci-lint version follows mise.toml golangci-lint

packageRules.description: Every toolchain bump (mise.toml and the matching files) lands in one PR
Go minor/major are deliberate migrations (Dockerfile builder, CI, ADRs): B-030
Node majors are deliberate LTS migrations (CI, Dockerfile): B-055; minor/patch within the pinned LTS line are proposed
